The '''New Republic officers' dress uniform''' was an official uniform worn by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] officers during formal occasions and gatherings. It was designed by a New Republic committee without any input from the people who would eventually wear it. As a result, many individuals simply did not care for the uniform.<ref name="Soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>

It started with a black sleeveless turtleneck body stocking and [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. A V-necked white jacket that fastened at about navel level and below went over the body stocking. A rank designation in gold above the wearer's left [[Breast/Legends|breast]] was located on the red band that ran along the left hem of the garment, up over the shoulder and at an angle down the back. Finally, a gray belt over the jacket completed the outfit.<ref name="Soa" />

There were variations to the dress uniform, with [[Rebel Fleet Command/Legends|Fleet Command]] using gray body stockings and [[New Republic Starfighter Command/Legends|Starfighter Command]] utilizing black. Higher-ranking officers were allowed to wear costlier and better-kept versions of their day uniforms in formal circumstances.
